    projects = ['A','B','C','D','E','F','G','H','I','J','K','L']
    v = {...}
    cost = {...}
    p = {...}
    r = {...}
    budgets = [110,100,90]
    P=28; R=32; max_proj=8

    m = gp.Model("Portafoglio")
    m.ModelSense = GRB.MAXIMIZE
    x = m.addVars(projects, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")  # name? varname "x_A"?
    yAC = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="y_AC")
    yEK = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="y_EK")

    # obj

    m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MAXIMIZE)

    # constraints
    for t in range(3):

    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(p[i]*x[i] for i in projects) <= P, name="personale")
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(r[i]*x[i] for i in projects) <= R, name="rischio")
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[i] for i in projects) <= max_proj, name="max_progetti")

    m.addConstr(x['G'] <= x['B'], name="G_requires_B")
    m.addConstr(x['J'] <= x['E'], name="J_requires_E")
    m.addConstr(x['K'] <= x['C'], name="K_requires_C")

    m.addConstr(x['A'] + x['C'] + x['G'] + x['J'] >= 2, name="digitali")
    m.addConstr(x['E'] + x['H'] + x['K'] >= 1, name="sostenibili")

    m.addConstr(yAC <= x['C'], name="yAC_le_C")
    m.addConstr(yAC >= x['A'] + x['C'] - 1, name="yAC_ge_AC")
    m.addConstr(yEK <= x['E'], name="yEK_le_E")
    m.addConstr(yEK <= x['K'], name="yEK_le_K")
    m.addConstr(yEK >= x['E'] + x['K'] - 1, name="yEK_ge_EK")

    m.optimize()
